fields.name: Objects
fields.evidence: NoesisGameUI.dll+0x44F9D0 (Toolkit, VMRemotePlayerDataSingletonComponent::CreateVM(EntityHandle const&), paired with bg3.exe+0x1663A70) hashes the EntityHandle key modulo the bucket count at this+8, asserts 'Tried to register a VMPlayer to the same entity twice', allocates a gui::VMPlayer (Noesis::BaseObject::operator_new(0x298)), inserts the key (FUN_1800f88d0) and stores the object in the values storage at this+0x30 (stride 8, capacity at this+0x38); IndexedStorage assert names the value type Noesis::Ptr<gui::VMPlayer> (8 bytes, written as void*). Destructor NoesisGameUI.dll+0x30B670 frees +0x30, +0x20, +0x10, +0 = HashSet(buckets +0, NextIds +0x10, Keys +0x20) + values +0x30. Toolkit also has HasPlayerObject(EntityHandle). Registry size 64 (coverage.json, client).

summary: Client UI (Noesis) registry: one gui::VMPlayer view-model per registered remote-player entity (other players in multiplayer), keyed by the entity; filled by gui::registration::VMPlayerRegistrationSystem::ProcessRemotePlayers. Singleton from game start; in the single-player samples (idle) it is always empty (all zero).
open_questions: Values are Noesis::Ptr<gui::VMPlayer>; exposed as void*. Never seen non-empty (no multiplayer sample).
live_reason: only empty (all-zero) instances were seen: the member boundaries are untested
